title: Worklist
purpose: Prioritize requested tests and assign eligible work to an existing open analytical batch. Each row represents one sample’s requested test.
summary: See every requested test that is not yet approved, most urgent holding deadline first, and add eligible tests to an open analytical batch.

tasks.title: Find the most urgent work
steps: Read the list from the top. It starts with the earliest holding deadline.
To see only urgent work, set [[Holding time]] to At risk or expired and select [[Apply]].

tasks.title: Add tests to a batch
steps: Check the tests to add. Rows that cannot be added say why.
Under Add selected tests to batch, choose the batch.

tasks.title: Start a new batch
steps: Select [[New batch]], choose the method and matrix, then add tests from the batch.

good_to_know: A deadline shows a pill only when it is at risk or expired. Otherwise the time left is quiet text.
This deadline counts from collection. Clocks that start at preparation are checked when results are entered.
If any checked test cannot go into the chosen batch, none are added.
Samples on hold or rejected at receipt cannot be added. Approved work is moved for reanalysis from the batch's Add tests page.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: These are staff pages. Active users with an application staff role can read them; client accounts cannot. Analysts perform result entry and batch work, reviewers decide results, and administrators maintain configuration. Administrators also have operational analyst and reviewer access, but independence rules still apply. Superuser status alone does not grant an application role.

items.label: Search
items.description: Find partial, case-insensitive matches in lab ID, client sample ID, client name, project name, chain-of-custody reference or analyte name.

items.label: Method
items.description: Select an active exact method version; Any method leaves all versions in scope.

items.label: Status
items.description: Defaults to Not yet approved, excluding approved results. Choices also include Not in a batch, Sent to an external laboratory, In batch, awaiting entry, Entered, Awaiting review, Returned, Approved and All statuses. Active external dispatch takes precedence over internal status.

items.label: Holding time
items.description: Expired includes running collection clocks past their deadline. At risk or expired also includes clocks within their configured warning window. These filters only include not-batched, awaiting-entry or returned work with a collection-based deadline.

items.label: More filters
items.description: Expand Matrix, Client, In batch, Received from and Received to.

items.label: Matrix
items.description: Water, Wastewater or Soil for the requested test definition.

items.label: Client
items.description: Restrict tests to one client across its projects.

items.label: In batch
items.description: Current analytical batch assignment. Enter a positive batch number such as B-000123, B123 or 123; invalid text shows an error and no rows.

items.label: Received from
items.description: Optional inclusive first receipt date in laboratory local time.

items.label: Received to
items.description: Optional inclusive last receipt date in laboratory local time.

items.label: Sample
items.description: Lab sample ID linking to receipt, custody and requested tests.

items.label: Analyte
items.description: Requested analyte and configured test unit.

items.label: Status
items.description: Derived work status. A receipt Hold or Reject is displayed instead and prevents selection.

items.label: Method
items.description: Exact method version and requested matrix.

items.label: Hold deadline
items.description: Earliest deadline from active collection-start rules for the requested method and matrix. Composite collection uses its recorded end. Running work shows the time left as quiet text; inside the rule's warning window it becomes an At risk pill with the time left, and past the deadline an Expired pill with how long ago. Preparation-based clocks are not represented by this queue deadline; result entry evaluates applicable clocks.

items.label: Batch
items.description: Current assigned batch link, or a dash when unassigned.

items.label: Client / project
items.description: Order’s client and project; hidden initially.

items.label: Received
items.description: Receipt date and time; hidden initially.

items.label: Collected
items.description: Collection event date and time, meaning composite end where applicable; hidden initially.

items.label: New batch
items.description: Analysts create a batch for one method version and matrix.

items.label: Add selected tests to batch
items.description: Choose an open analytical batch identified by number, method and matrix. Its presence in the list does not mean it matches every checked test.

items.label: Add selected to batch
items.description: Analysts assign checked tests. The header checkbox selects eligible rows on this page only. Entered, submitted, approved and external rows are disabled here, as are samples held or rejected at receipt. Use the destination batch’s Add tests page for approved reanalysis.

items.label: Selection checks
items.description: The server rechecks method, active definition, both test and sample matrix, receipt disposition, disposal, external dispatch, open revisions and preparation chronology. Any failed selection blocks the assignment as a whole. Already-assigned tests are skipped. Entered or submitted work cannot move; returned work can.

sections.title: Filtering and table controls

items.label: Apply
items.description: Apply search and filters to the entire matching dataset and return to page 1. Invalid filters show errors and no rows; they never widen the query.

items.label: Clear all
items.description: Remove search and filters and restore this page’s defaults. A filter chip removes only that filter.

items.label: Rows per page
items.description: Choose 25 (default), 50 or 100. First, Previous, Next and Last page links retain filters. Counts describe all matching records.

items.label: Columns
items.description: Show or hide optional columns and change their order using movement controls or header dragging. Changes apply immediately and are saved for this table in your account, on any workstation. Locked columns stay available.

items.label: Reset columns
items.description: Restore the original column visibility and order. Done or Close dismisses the Columns dialog.

paragraphs: Initially sorted by earliest collection-based Hold deadline, missing deadlines last. Sample, Analyte, Hold deadline and Received headings sort the entire filtered worklist; click again to reverse.

sections.title: Empty and changed work
paragraphs: No open work means no rows remain under the default not-yet-approved view. Received samples with requested tests populate this queue. Clear filters or use All statuses when appropriate. Assignment reports its added count and returns to the current worklist URL. Selection does not carry across pages.
